content: WKWebView has no Chrome extension support; specialized browsers such as Orion must fork WebKit, which breaks FairPlay VMP. WKWebView supports FairPlay/EME but not Widevine; services requiring VMP fail. WKProcessPool is deprecated and multiple pools no longer isolate processes; WKWebsiteDataStore controls cookies/storage. WKContentWorld provides isolated JS worlds in WebKit, but wry does not expose world selection.
